Valhalla is calling!

Play as the leader of the Vikings and lead your Tribe to conquer Midgard! Embark on your quest alongside famous Heroes from Viking history.
In this competitive global game, what enemies will you encounter? What friendships will you gain?

[Viking Rise] is an online multiplayer, real-time war strategy game. You play as a Viking ruler, guiding your Tribe throughout Valhalla in the uncharted world of Midgard. Explore, plunder, hunt, and fight your way across Valhalla to accrue massive wealth, fame, and power. Form alliances with other players, protect one another, and defeat all enemies to conquer Midgard!

Features

▶▶ Audiovisual Masterpiece ◀◀
Step into the world of the Vikings. Explore stunning oceans and towering mountains, experience realistic seasonal changes, and marvel at the beauty of the vast Nordic landscape. Immerse yourself in the world of Midgard with an original soundtrack composed by the renowned Mikolaj Stroinski.

▶▶ Global Multi-Player Battles ◀◀
Challenge players around the world or fight alongside allies. Prove you have what it takes to be a Viking leader. Balance strategy, diplomacy, or warfare as you stake your claim on Midgard and build your empire in Valhalla.

▶▶ Design Your Territory ◀◀
Conquer Valhalla and recruit talent to expand your territory and grow your Tribe. Personalize your territory with Viking-style structures. Develop your land into a commercial trading center, an area of rich resources, or a powerful military fortress.

▶▶ Naval Combat ◀◀
Lead your Vikings across unknown waters to seize new lands in Valhalla! Use the sea to your advantage to ambush enemies and plunder their resources, sail to overtake opponents on land in the race for strategic territories, or use your ship to retreat from unfavorable situations. Combine your navigational and naval combat skills to invent greater strategies!

▶▶ Real-Time Combat ◀◀
Fight your enemies in real-time on a massive world map. Survey your battlefields and give commands in real-time. Form alliances and adjust your strategy to devastate your foes and become the strongest in Midgard.

▶▶ Fight Alongside Viking Heroes ◀◀
Recruit legendary Viking Heroes to join you in war and become a true Viking ruler! Summon Ragnar, Bjorn, Ival the Boneless, Snake-Eyed Sigurd, Harald Bluetooth, Rollo, Valkyrie, and other famous figures from Norse mythology to fight for you.

▶▶ Tame the Ancient Dragon ◀◀
Send your Heroes to hunt down raging beasts from Norse mythology. Seek treasure in mysterious ruins and caves. Tame the mighty mythical dragon and obtain a powerful combat boost. Make a name for yourself as one of Midgard's greatest legends!
